761650101.text: Hmm... Looks like a Ratnik's gravestone. Could it be from those Ratniki we saw in the canyon?

761650102.text: They keep flickering in and out, showing up one moment and vanishing the next...

761650103.text: Hmm, Paimon still doesn't get what's going on. Let's ask around in Piramida next time! Maybe someone there knows about this.

761650201.text: Oh, greetings. I'm Patolichev, quartermaster of the Lightkeepers. How can I help you?

761650202.text: Are you Patolichev of the Frostgale Steeds?

761650203.text: The Frostgale Steeds... Ah, you mean those strange shadows we saw earlier...

761650204.text: Yes, that was the squad I once served with. The Frostgale Steeds... It's been a long time since I've heard that name. I never thought I'd hear it from someone else's mouth... May I ask how you...?

761650206.text: Yep! And we took care of the Wild Hunt that was causing trouble there!

761650207.text: We even saw the Ratniki from the Frostgale Steeds... their shadows still lingering from their fight against the Wild Hunt...

761650210.text: I can't believe it was real...

761650211.text: Of course it was! We saw it with our own eyes!

761650212.text: Ah... Over the years, people have told me from time to time of how they've seen the figures of my fallen comrades at Kipumaki Cliff. That's why even now, I still go there often... and tend to their graves while I'm there.

761650213.text: But not once... not even once, have I ever seen them myself. It's been so long... I thought those stories were just kind lies to comfort me.

761650214.text: And yet you truly saw them... Why is it that whenever I go, they never show themselves to me?

761650209.text: Yes... and even if only their shadows remain, those shadows still show them locked in battle with the Wild Hunt...
